breakdown.description: The load is extended from the intended top-right segment to the whole top edge
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the contradictory instructions regarding the shear traction. It ignored the incorrect instruction to apply the load to the 'full top boundary' and instead specified applying it only 'on the top-right segment of the upper edge where y = 1 and x > 0.5', which aligns perfectly with the ground truth.
